identificationModule.briefTitle: Study of Cordycepin Plus Pentostatin in Patients With Refractory TdT-Positive Leukemia
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase I/II Study of Cordycepin Plus Pentostatin in Patients With Refractory TdT-Positive Leukemia

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a two-part, open-label, Phase I/II study in subjects with relapsed or refractory TdT-positive leukemia for which no standard therapies are expected to result in durable remission.

interventions.name: Cordycepin plus Pentostatin
interventions.description: Cordycepin Plus Pentostatin on days 1, 2 and 3 of a 21 day cycle. Number of cycles until progression or unacceptable toxicity

primaryOutcomes.measure: Establishment of the recommended dose (RD) of cordycepin, given one hour following a fixed dose of the ADA inhibitor pentostatin, in subjects with refractory TdT-positive leukemia

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Determination of the single and multiple dose pharmacokinetics of cordycepin. Measurement and quantification any any clinical responses following administration of cordycepin/pentostatin at the recomme

locations.facility: Cancer Therapy Reasearch Center at UTHSCA
